initial_state: Same position and velocity from frozen scene; identical minimum-norm shared feasible acceleration trim for all methods
initialization_selection: All four native initial robust/sampled constraints, no goal progress or outcome search
execution_reference: Critically damped nominal-acceleration reference, only in QP objective, never post-filtering safe control
optional_detour_reachability: Only for Gamma/direction candidates/final augmented QP: intersect safe command set with ||u-a_actual||_1<=0.25. Pause optional detour if no current capacity; retain the already valid base safety command.
tracking_preference_priority: Try native-objective QP inside ||u-a_actual||_1<=0.25, then <=0.4. If neither feasible, execute the already feasible original hard-safe QP command and record fallback. Never report optional preference infeasibility as native QP failure.
